personal_info.name: Wei Zhang
personal_info.summary: Machine learning engineer with 3 years of experience taking models from research notebooks to production, specializing in NLP and recommendation systems using PyTorch and TensorFlow.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer
responsibilities: Built and deployed a PyTorch-based home-price recommendation model serving 500k+ predictions/day
Fine-tuned a BERT-based NLP model to extract structured features from listing descriptions
Built a feature store and model-serving pipeline with Airflow and Docker on top of an MLOps stack
Ran A/B tests to measure model impact on user engagement, driving a 6% lift in click-through rate

experience.title: Machine Learning Research Assistant
responsibilities: Researched transformer-based text classification models under a faculty advisor
Co-authored a workshop paper on low-resource NLP fine-tuning techniques

projects.name: Movie Recommendation Engine
description: Built a collaborative-filtering recommendation system in PyTorch trained on the MovieLens dataset
Deployed as a FastAPI service with a Redis-backed feature cache

publications.title: Low-Resource Fine-Tuning Strategies for Transformer Text Classifiers
publications.description: Workshop paper on data-efficient fine-tuning techniques for low-resource text classification.
